items.html: And this is “and the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom”: for in the generation of the people of Sodom, Malchut was in the back of the NHY of ZA, as above, in the secret of “And the Lord rained.” But now, she fell in the secret of a point alone, under the Yesod, and her ten Sefirot descended into the Klipot — all the more so the illumination of the five [Sefirot] that fell in the destruction of the First Temple.
